brand.name: DocuMark
brand.tagline: Markdown Specification Reader, Diagram Renderer & Print Workbench

landing.heading: Read Markdown specifications, render Mermaid diagrams, and export print-ready PDFs.
landing.description: Upload raw .md or .markdown files up to 2 MB. DocuMark stores your specification text directly in PostgreSQL, renders GitHub Flavored Markdown with syntax-highlighted code blocks and Mermaid flowcharts, and formats high-contrast pages for PDF export.

capabilities.gfmBody: Renders tables, task lists, strikethroughs, and autolinks through a strict rehype-sanitize pipeline that strips unsafe scripts while preserving language tokens.
capabilities.mermaidBody: Detects fenced mermaid blocks and compiles flowcharts, sequence diagrams, and entity-relationship diagrams into scalable vector graphics.
capabilities.storageBody: Persists UTF-8 Markdown content directly inside PostgreSQL TEXT columns via Prisma ORM, keeping history queries fast by excluding raw content until opened.
capabilities.pdfBody: Forces high-contrast paper styling and re-renders diagrams in light mode during print capture so multi-page PDF exports stay legible.

auth.loginSubtitle: Enter your registered email and password to access your Markdown workspace and upload history.
auth.registerSubtitle: Register an account to upload .md files, render diagrams, and save your specification history.

dashboard.title: Document Workspace
dashboard.subtitle: Upload a new Markdown file to open it immediately in the reader, or reopen a saved specification from your PostgreSQL history.
dashboard.uploadInstructions: Drag and drop a .md or .markdown file here, or use the file browser button below.
dashboard.uploadConstraints: Accepted extensions: .md, .markdown. Maximum file size: 2 MB (UTF-8 text).
dashboard.uploadingState: Validating UTF-8 encoding and saving document to PostgreSQL...
dashboard.historyDescription: Loaded via metadata-only query (raw Markdown content is fetched only when you open a document).
dashboard.historyEmptyAction: Select or drop a .md file in the upload panel to store and render your first document.
dashboard.historyLoading: Loading your document history from PostgreSQL...
dashboard.confirmDeleteBody: This permanently removes the Markdown file from PostgreSQL. You can re-upload the file from your device later.
